text:
amanda_sales: Looping in eng & security — NewVerge wants a POC next week. Main asks: SSO via Okta (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC/group mapping, domain verification for shared email domains, and a POC pricing comparison (Dedicated vs Hosted). Any immediate blockers?

raj_engineer: Quick Q — they expect ~2k MAU during POC with bursty periods up to ~150 r/s. For latency predictability we usually recommend Dedicated; Hosted can work with quotas + rate limits. Also: SCIM delta + bulk sync support needed for initial import.

lee_solutions: Recommend Hosted for fastest onboarding unless they require VPC or EU isolation. RBAC: we support mapping SCIM groups -> roles and can apply precedence rules. Do they need delegated admin features?

marta_security: Security notes — confirm they want SAML assertions signed AND encrypted attributes. If they push for Private we need KMS/HSM integration confirmed. I sent them the security questionnaire link: https://redwood.ai/sec-qa — ask them to fill before kickoff.

amanda_sales: Customer says "prefer Hosted" but legal flagged EU residency so Private might be requested. For pricing they want a POC quote that compares reserved Dedicated hours vs hosted overage costs. @raj_engineer can you draft a rough costing matrix?

raj_engineer: Will do. Infra heads-up: our SCIM provisioning rate currently defaults to 5 req/s with 429 backoff. For large initial syncs we advise a bulk export/import or staggered sync window. Example SCIM PATCH we give partners for status changes:

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/12345
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [ { "op": "replace", "value": { "active": true } } ]
}
```

Also note we expose a bulk endpoint for faster initial imports — will include instructions in the SOW.

lee_solutions: On domain proofing: we support TXT record verification for domains (e.g., _redwood.newverge.com) and tenant locking for domain+email claim. Multiple domains can be mapped to one tenant if needed.

marta_security: One more — SAML caveats: SP-initiated logout has some corner cases with session propagation; we support signed AuthnRequests and SHA256 signatures. Confirm session timeout expectations so we can set session SLOs.

amanda_sales: They also asked if an Okta group can map to multiple roles and whether we support hierarchical role precedence. @raj_engineer?

raj_engineer: Yes — we support mapping a single group to multiple roles and explicit priority determines precedence. For the POC we can enable group->role mapping UI and show a demo. Also can pin model versions per-tenant during canary tests.

lee_solutions: Action items from our side:
1) Draft POC SOW (duration, throughput targets, deployment mode options).
2) Pricing matrix: Hosted vs Dedicated for POC window + estimated overages.
3) Prepare SAML metadata, sample SCIM bulk import guide, and security answers.
@amanda_sales I will prepare the SOW template and sample configs.

deploy-bot: deploy 1812349007: provision-dedicated-poc pool created (4x A10G) — ETA ~2h :rocket:

amanda_sales: Thanks all — can we aim to have quote + SOW + sample SAML metadata by EOD Friday? Customer wants kickoff Monday. :pray:
